lines.text: Bavaria, nineteen twenty two. A lonely farm called Hinterkaifeck.
lines.beat_before: the farm in its clearing at dusk

lines.text: The house keys go missing. A newspaper turns up that nobody bought.
lines.beat_before: key board, an empty hook; a paper on the table

lines.text: At night, the farmer hears footsteps in the attic.
lines.beat_before: the lamp-lit room, dust from the ceiling boards

lines.text: He searches with a lantern. He finds nothing.
lines.beat_before: from the dark attic: the lantern rises through the hatch

lines.text: Months earlier, the maid had quit. She said the house was haunted.
On the last night of March, all six people on the farm were killed.
lines.beat_before: one lit window at night; it goes dark

lines.text: For days, smoke rose from the chimney. Someone fed the cattle.
lines.beat_before: silence; the silent farm, smoke; the barn

lines.text: Whoever did it had stayed in the house.
No one knows how long someone had been living above them.
lines.beat_before: a hollow in the attic hay
